title: tc-breadcrumbs
description: A trail of links to the current page that folds its middle into "…" when it doesn't fit.

items.description: The trail, from the top down; the last item is the current page

separator.description: Between items: a chevron or a slash

max.description: Show at most this many items (the first, "…" and the last ones), even when more would fit

copyPath.description: Adds a button that copies the trail as text

pathSeparator.description: What the copied trail is joined with

href.description: A link; without one the item is a button that fires tc-navigate

id.description: Your own key for the item, handed back in tc-navigate

icon.description: A small icon before the label
